publisherChecksum.verification: Publisher claim; see actual served-byte sample hashes separately.

libraryOverrides.license: Original author terms apply; metadata links retain the original publisher file locations.
libraryOverrides.compatibility: The user states Cherax vehicle/outfit data works in Scooby and Nenyoo, and both local source trees expose matching JSON format importers. Nine public JSON samples match those general structures. This is not an individual game test of all catalog entries.
compatibilityLimitations: Scooby Cherax outfit normalization currently resolves the named Hands component to slot 3 via StandOutfits; Nenyoo uses slot 5. Clothing fidelity can differ.
Scooby normalized outfit application passes palette 0 and handles clothing/props; complete Cherax appearance fields are not established by this path.
Nenyoo named-prop import handles slots 0..7 and omits Hip; named Cherax face_features are not the featureN keys read in its face-feature branch.
Nenyoo vehicle apply_cherax handles a subset of Cherax vehicle fields; Scooby and Nenyoo may differ in attachment and cosmetic fidelity.
Model availability, clothing indices and DLC resources depend on the installed GTA edition/build.
No compatibility extension to Lua, themes or translations is inferred from these data importers.
requirements: Matching Cherax JSON resource importer
Intended vehicle/character model and edition-compatible resources

libraryOverrides.compatibility: The user states Cherax vehicle/outfit data works in Scooby and Nenyoo, and both local source trees expose matching JSON format importers. Nine public JSON samples match those general structures. This is not an individual game test of all catalog entries.
compatibilityLimitations: Scooby Cherax outfit normalization currently resolves the named Hands component to slot 3 via StandOutfits; Nenyoo uses slot 5. Clothing fidelity can differ.
Scooby normalized outfit application passes palette 0 and handles clothing/props; complete Cherax appearance fields are not established by this path.
Nenyoo named-prop import handles slots 0..7 and omits Hip; named Cherax face_features are not the featureN keys read in its face-feature branch.
Nenyoo vehicle apply_cherax handles a subset of Cherax vehicle fields; Scooby and Nenyoo may differ in attachment and cosmetic fidelity.
Model availability, clothing indices and DLC resources depend on the installed GTA edition/build.
No compatibility extension to Lua, themes or translations is inferred from these data importers.
requirements: Matching Cherax JSON resource importer
Intended vehicle/character model and edition-compatible resources

publisherChecksum.verification: Publisher claim; see actual served-byte sample hashes separately.

libraryOverrides.license: Original author terms apply; metadata links retain the original publisher file locations.
libraryOverrides.compatibility: The user states Cherax vehicle/outfit data works in Scooby and Nenyoo, and both local source trees expose matching JSON format importers. Nine public JSON samples match those general structures. This is not an individual game test of all catalog entries.
compatibilityLimitations: Scooby Cherax outfit normalization currently resolves the named Hands component to slot 3 via StandOutfits; Nenyoo uses slot 5. Clothing fidelity can differ.
Scooby normalized outfit application passes palette 0 and handles clothing/props; complete Cherax appearance fields are not established by this path.
Nenyoo named-prop import handles slots 0..7 and omits Hip; named Cherax face_features are not the featureN keys read in its face-feature branch.
Nenyoo vehicle apply_cherax handles a subset of Cherax vehicle fields; Scooby and Nenyoo may differ in attachment and cosmetic fidelity.
Model availability, clothing indices and DLC resources depend on the installed GTA edition/build.
No compatibility extension to Lua, themes or translations is inferred from these data importers.
requirements: Matching Cherax JSON resource importer
Intended vehicle/character model and edition-compatible resources

libraryOverrides.license: Original author terms apply; metadata links retain the original publisher file locations.
libraryOverrides.compatibility: The user states Cherax vehicle/outfit data works in Scooby and Nenyoo, and both local source trees expose matching JSON format importers. Nine public JSON samples match those general structures. This is not an individual game test of all catalog entries.
compatibilityLimitations: Scooby Cherax outfit normalization currently resolves the named Hands component to slot 3 via StandOutfits; Nenyoo uses slot 5. Clothing fidelity can differ.
Scooby normalized outfit application passes palette 0 and handles clothing/props; complete Cherax appearance fields are not established by this path.
Nenyoo named-prop import handles slots 0..7 and omits Hip; named Cherax face_features are not the featureN keys read in its face-feature branch.
Nenyoo vehicle apply_cherax handles a subset of Cherax vehicle fields; Scooby and Nenyoo may differ in attachment and cosmetic fidelity.
Model availability, clothing indices and DLC resources depend on the installed GTA edition/build.
No compatibility extension to Lua, themes or translations is inferred from these data importers.
requirements: Matching Cherax JSON resource importer
Intended vehicle/character model and edition-compatible resources

libraryOverrides.compatibility: The user states Cherax vehicle/outfit data works in Scooby and Nenyoo, and both local source trees expose matching JSON format importers. Nine public JSON samples match those general structures. This is not an individual game test of all catalog entries.
compatibilityLimitations: Scooby Cherax outfit normalization currently resolves the named Hands component to slot 3 via StandOutfits; Nenyoo uses slot 5. Clothing fidelity can differ.
Scooby normalized outfit application passes palette 0 and handles clothing/props; complete Cherax appearance fields are not established by this path.
Nenyoo named-prop import handles slots 0..7 and omits Hip; named Cherax face_features are not the featureN keys read in its face-feature branch.
Nenyoo vehicle apply_cherax handles a subset of Cherax vehicle fields; Scooby and Nenyoo may differ in attachment and cosmetic fidelity.
Model availability, clothing indices and DLC resources depend on the installed GTA edition/build.
No compatibility extension to Lua, themes or translations is inferred from these data importers.
requirements: Matching Cherax JSON resource importer

Model availability, clothing indices and DLC resources depend on the installed GTA edition/build.

libraryOverrides.license: Original author terms apply; metadata links retain the original publisher file locations.
libraryOverrides.compatibility: The user states Cherax vehicle/outfit data works in Scooby and Nenyoo, and both local source trees expose matching JSON format importers. Nine public JSON samples match those general structures. This is not an individual game test of all catalog entries.
compatibilityLimitations: Scooby Cherax outfit normalization currently resolves the named Hands component to slot 3 via StandOutfits; Nenyoo uses slot 5. Clothing fidelity can differ.
Scooby normalized outfit application passes palette 0 and handles clothing/props; complete Cherax appearance fields are not established by this path.
Nenyoo named-prop import handles slots 0..7 and omits Hip; named Cherax face_features are not the featureN keys read in its face-feature branch.
Nenyoo vehicle apply_cherax handles a subset of Cherax vehicle fields; Scooby and Nenyoo may differ in attachment and cosmetic fidelity.
Model availability, clothing indices and DLC resources depend on the installed GTA edition/build.
No compatibility extension to Lua, themes or translations is inferred from these data importers.
requirements: Matching Cherax JSON resource importer
Intended vehicle/character model and edition-compatible resources

compatibilityLimitations: Scooby Cherax outfit normalization currently resolves the named Hands component to slot 3 via StandOutfits; Nenyoo uses slot 5. Clothing fidelity can differ.
Scooby normalized outfit application passes palette 0 and handles clothing/props; complete Cherax appearance fields are not established by this path.
Nenyoo named-prop import handles slots 0..7 and omits Hip; named Cherax face_features are not the featureN keys read in its face-feature branch.
Nenyoo vehicle apply_cherax handles a subset of Cherax vehicle fields; Scooby and Nenyoo may differ in attachment and cosmetic fidelity.
Model availability, clothing indices and DLC resources depend on the installed GTA edition/build.
No compatibility extension to Lua, themes or translations is inferred from these data importers.
requirements: Matching Cherax JSON resource importer

libraryOverrides.license: Original author terms apply; metadata links retain the original publisher file locations.
libraryOverrides.compatibility: The user states Cherax vehicle/outfit data works in Scooby and Nenyoo, and both local source trees expose matching JSON format importers. Nine public JSON samples match those general structures. This is not an individual game test of all catalog entries.
compatibilityLimitations: Scooby Cherax outfit normalization currently resolves the named Hands component to slot 3 via StandOutfits; Nenyoo uses slot 5. Clothing fidelity can differ.
Scooby normalized outfit application passes palette 0 and handles clothing/props; complete Cherax appearance fields are not established by this path.
Nenyoo named-prop import handles slots 0..7 and omits Hip; named Cherax face_features are not the featureN keys read in its face-feature branch.
Nenyoo vehicle apply_cherax handles a subset of Cherax vehicle fields; Scooby and Nenyoo may differ in attachment and cosmetic fidelity.
Model availability, clothing indices and DLC resources depend on the installed GTA edition/build.
No compatibility extension to Lua, themes or translations is inferred from these data importers.
requirements: Matching Cherax JSON resource importer
Intended vehicle/character model and edition-compatible resources

libraryOverrides.compatibility: The user states Cherax vehicle/outfit data works in Scooby and Nenyoo, and both local source trees expose matching JSON format importers. Nine public JSON samples match those general structures. This is not an individual game test of all catalog entries.
compatibilityLimitations: Scooby Cherax outfit normalization currently resolves the named Hands component to slot 3 via StandOutfits; Nenyoo uses slot 5. Clothing fidelity can differ.
Scooby normalized outfit application passes palette 0 and handles clothing/props; complete Cherax appearance fields are not established by this path.
Nenyoo named-prop import handles slots 0..7 and omits Hip; named Cherax face_features are not the featureN keys read in its face-feature branch.
Nenyoo vehicle apply_cherax handles a subset of Cherax vehicle fields; Scooby and Nenyoo may differ in attachment and cosmetic fidelity.
Model availability, clothing indices and DLC resources depend on the installed GTA edition/build.
No compatibility extension to Lua, themes or translations is inferred from these data importers.

compatibilityLimitations: Scooby Cherax outfit normalization currently resolves the named Hands component to slot 3 via StandOutfits; Nenyoo uses slot 5. Clothing fidelity can differ.

Nenyoo vehicle apply_cherax handles a subset of Cherax vehicle fields; Scooby and Nenyoo may differ in attachment and cosmetic fidelity.
Model availability, clothing indices and DLC resources depend on the installed GTA edition/build.
No compatibility extension to Lua, themes or translations is inferred from these data importers.

libraryOverrides.license: Original author terms apply; metadata links retain the original publisher file locations.
libraryOverrides.compatibility: The user states Cherax vehicle/outfit data works in Scooby and Nenyoo, and both local source trees expose matching JSON format importers. Nine public JSON samples match those general structures. This is not an individual game test of all catalog entries.
compatibilityLimitations: Scooby Cherax outfit normalization currently resolves the named Hands component to slot 3 via StandOutfits; Nenyoo uses slot 5. Clothing fidelity can differ.
Scooby normalized outfit application passes palette 0 and handles clothing/props; complete Cherax appearance fields are not established by this path.
Nenyoo named-prop import handles slots 0..7 and omits Hip; named Cherax face_features are not the featureN keys read in its face-feature branch.
Nenyoo vehicle apply_cherax handles a subset of Cherax vehicle fields; Scooby and Nenyoo may differ in attachment and cosmetic fidelity.
Model availability, clothing indices and DLC resources depend on the installed GTA edition/build.
No compatibility extension to Lua, themes or translations is inferred from these data importers.
requirements: Matching Cherax JSON resource importer

libraryOverrides.license: Original author terms apply; metadata links retain the original publisher file locations.
libraryOverrides.compatibility: The user states Cherax vehicle/outfit data works in Scooby and Nenyoo, and both local source trees expose matching JSON format importers. Nine public JSON samples match those general structures. This is not an individual game test of all catalog entries.
compatibilityLimitations: Scooby Cherax outfit normalization currently resolves the named Hands component to slot 3 via StandOutfits; Nenyoo uses slot 5. Clothing fidelity can differ.
Scooby normalized outfit application passes palette 0 and handles clothing/props; complete Cherax appearance fields are not established by this path.
Nenyoo named-prop import handles slots 0..7 and omits Hip; named Cherax face_features are not the featureN keys read in its face-feature branch.
Nenyoo vehicle apply_cherax handles a subset of Cherax vehicle fields; Scooby and Nenyoo may differ in attachment and cosmetic fidelity.
Model availability, clothing indices and DLC resources depend on the installed GTA edition/build.
No compatibility extension to Lua, themes or translations is inferred from these data importers.
requirements: Matching Cherax JSON resource importer
Intended vehicle/character model and edition-compatible resources

compatibilityLimitations: Scooby Cherax outfit normalization currently resolves the named Hands component to slot 3 via StandOutfits; Nenyoo uses slot 5. Clothing fidelity can differ.

Nenyoo named-prop import handles slots 0..7 and omits Hip; named Cherax face_features are not the featureN keys read in its face-feature branch.
Nenyoo vehicle apply_cherax handles a subset of Cherax vehicle fields; Scooby and Nenyoo may differ in attachment and cosmetic fidelity.
Model availability, clothing indices and DLC resources depend on the installed GTA edition/build.
No compatibility extension to Lua, themes or translations is inferred from these data importers.

libraryOverrides.license: Original author terms apply; metadata links retain the original publisher file locations.
libraryOverrides.compatibility: The user states Cherax vehicle/outfit data works in Scooby and Nenyoo, and both local source trees expose matching JSON format importers. Nine public JSON samples match those general structures. This is not an individual game test of all catalog entries.
compatibilityLimitations: Scooby Cherax outfit normalization currently resolves the named Hands component to slot 3 via StandOutfits; Nenyoo uses slot 5. Clothing fidelity can differ.
Scooby normalized outfit application passes palette 0 and handles clothing/props; complete Cherax appearance fields are not established by this path.
Nenyoo named-prop import handles slots 0..7 and omits Hip; named Cherax face_features are not the featureN keys read in its face-feature branch.
Nenyoo vehicle apply_cherax handles a subset of Cherax vehicle fields; Scooby and Nenyoo may differ in attachment and cosmetic fidelity.
Model availability, clothing indices and DLC resources depend on the installed GTA edition/build.
No compatibility extension to Lua, themes or translations is inferred from these data importers.
requirements: Matching Cherax JSON resource importer
Intended vehicle/character model and edition-compatible resources

libraryOverrides.license: Original author terms apply; metadata links retain the original publisher file locations.
libraryOverrides.compatibility: The user states Cherax vehicle/outfit data works in Scooby and Nenyoo, and both local source trees expose matching JSON format importers. Nine public JSON samples match those general structures. This is not an individual game test of all catalog entries.
compatibilityLimitations: Scooby Cherax outfit normalization currently resolves the named Hands component to slot 3 via StandOutfits; Nenyoo uses slot 5. Clothing fidelity can differ.
Scooby normalized outfit application passes palette 0 and handles clothing/props; complete Cherax appearance fields are not established by this path.
Nenyoo named-prop import handles slots 0..7 and omits Hip; named Cherax face_features are not the featureN keys read in its face-feature branch.
Nenyoo vehicle apply_cherax handles a subset of Cherax vehicle fields; Scooby and Nenyoo may differ in attachment and cosmetic fidelity.
Model availability, clothing indices and DLC resources depend on the installed GTA edition/build.
No compatibility extension to Lua, themes or translations is inferred from these data importers.
requirements: Matching Cherax JSON resource importer
Intended vehicle/character model and edition-compatible resources

publisherChecksum.verification: Publisher claim; see actual served-byte sample hashes separately.

libraryOverrides.license: Original author terms apply; metadata links retain the original publisher file locations.
libraryOverrides.compatibility: The user states Cherax vehicle/outfit data works in Scooby and Nenyoo, and both local source trees expose matching JSON format importers. Nine public JSON samples match those general structures. This is not an individual game test of all catalog entries.
compatibilityLimitations: Scooby Cherax outfit normalization currently resolves the named Hands component to slot 3 via StandOutfits; Nenyoo uses slot 5. Clothing fidelity can differ.
Scooby normalized outfit application passes palette 0 and handles clothing/props; complete Cherax appearance fields are not established by this path.
Nenyoo named-prop import handles slots 0..7 and omits Hip; named Cherax face_features are not the featureN keys read in its face-feature branch.
Nenyoo vehicle apply_cherax handles a subset of Cherax vehicle fields; Scooby and Nenyoo may differ in attachment and cosmetic fidelity.
Model availability, clothing indices and DLC resources depend on the installed GTA edition/build.
No compatibility extension to Lua, themes or translations is inferred from these data importers.
requirements: Matching Cherax JSON resource importer
Intended vehicle/character model and edition-compatible resources

libraryOverrides.credits: Original developer unverified; shared by Robot

libraryOverrides.changelogBasis: No verified per-resource dated changelog supplied. Share dates and catalog update dates remain source timestamps.

publisherChecksum.verification: Publisher claim; see actual served-byte sample hashes separately.

libraryOverrides.license: Original author terms apply; metadata links retain the original publisher file locations.
libraryOverrides.compatibility: The user states Cherax vehicle/outfit data works in Scooby and Nenyoo, and both local source trees expose matching JSON format importers. Nine public JSON samples match those general structures. This is not an individual game test of all catalog entries.
compatibilityLimitations: Scooby Cherax outfit normalization currently resolves the named Hands component to slot 3 via StandOutfits; Nenyoo uses slot 5. Clothing fidelity can differ.
Scooby normalized outfit application passes palette 0 and handles clothing/props; complete Cherax appearance fields are not established by this path.
Nenyoo named-prop import handles slots 0..7 and omits Hip; named Cherax face_features are not the featureN keys read in its face-feature branch.
Nenyoo vehicle apply_cherax handles a subset of Cherax vehicle fields; Scooby and Nenyoo may differ in attachment and cosmetic fidelity.
Model availability, clothing indices and DLC resources depend on the installed GTA edition/build.
No compatibility extension to Lua, themes or translations is inferred from these data importers.
requirements: Matching Cherax JSON resource importer
Intended vehicle/character model and edition-compatible resources

publisherChecksum.verification: Publisher claim; see actual served-byte sample hashes separately.

libraryOverrides.license: Original author terms apply; metadata links retain the original publisher file locations.
libraryOverrides.compatibility: The user states Cherax vehicle/outfit data works in Scooby and Nenyoo, and both local source trees expose matching JSON format importers. Nine public JSON samples match those general structures. This is not an individual game test of all catalog entries.
compatibilityLimitations: Scooby Cherax outfit normalization currently resolves the named Hands component to slot 3 via StandOutfits; Nenyoo uses slot 5. Clothing fidelity can differ.
Scooby normalized outfit application passes palette 0 and handles clothing/props; complete Cherax appearance fields are not established by this path.
Nenyoo named-prop import handles slots 0..7 and omits Hip; named Cherax face_features are not the featureN keys read in its face-feature branch.
Nenyoo vehicle apply_cherax handles a subset of Cherax vehicle fields; Scooby and Nenyoo may differ in attachment and cosmetic fidelity.
Model availability, clothing indices and DLC resources depend on the installed GTA edition/build.
No compatibility extension to Lua, themes or translations is inferred from these data importers.
requirements: Matching Cherax JSON resource importer
Intended vehicle/character model and edition-compatible resources

publisherChecksum.verification: Publisher claim; see actual served-byte sample hashes separately.

libraryOverrides.license: Original author terms apply; metadata links retain the original publisher file locations.
libraryOverrides.compatibility: The user states Cherax vehicle/outfit data works in Scooby and Nenyoo, and both local source trees expose matching JSON format importers. Nine public JSON samples match those general structures. This is not an individual game test of all catalog entries.
compatibilityLimitations: Scooby Cherax outfit normalization currently resolves the named Hands component to slot 3 via StandOutfits; Nenyoo uses slot 5. Clothing fidelity can differ.
Scooby normalized outfit application passes palette 0 and handles clothing/props; complete Cherax appearance fields are not established by this path.
Nenyoo named-prop import handles slots 0..7 and omits Hip; named Cherax face_features are not the featureN keys read in its face-feature branch.
Nenyoo vehicle apply_cherax handles a subset of Cherax vehicle fields; Scooby and Nenyoo may differ in attachment and cosmetic fidelity.
Model availability, clothing indices and DLC resources depend on the installed GTA edition/build.
No compatibility extension to Lua, themes or translations is inferred from these data importers.
requirements: Matching Cherax JSON resource importer
Intended vehicle/character model and edition-compatible resources

libraryOverrides.compatibility: The user states Cherax vehicle/outfit data works in Scooby and Nenyoo, and both local source trees expose matching JSON format importers. Nine public JSON samples match those general structures. This is not an individual game test of all catalog entries.
compatibilityLimitations: Scooby Cherax outfit normalization currently resolves the named Hands component to slot 3 via StandOutfits; Nenyoo uses slot 5. Clothing fidelity can differ.
Scooby normalized outfit application passes palette 0 and handles clothing/props; complete Cherax appearance fields are not established by this path.
Nenyoo named-prop import handles slots 0..7 and omits Hip; named Cherax face_features are not the featureN keys read in its face-feature branch.
Nenyoo vehicle apply_cherax handles a subset of Cherax vehicle fields; Scooby and Nenyoo may differ in attachment and cosmetic fidelity.
Model availability, clothing indices and DLC resources depend on the installed GTA edition/build.
No compatibility extension to Lua, themes or translations is inferred from these data importers.

compatibilityLimitations: Scooby Cherax outfit normalization currently resolves the named Hands component to slot 3 via StandOutfits; Nenyoo uses slot 5. Clothing fidelity can differ.

Nenyoo named-prop import handles slots 0..7 and omits Hip; named Cherax face_features are not the featureN keys read in its face-feature branch.
Nenyoo vehicle apply_cherax handles a subset of Cherax vehicle fields; Scooby and Nenyoo may differ in attachment and cosmetic fidelity.
Model availability, clothing indices and DLC resources depend on the installed GTA edition/build.
No compatibility extension to Lua, themes or translations is inferred from these data importers.

compatibilityLimitations: Scooby Cherax outfit normalization currently resolves the named Hands component to slot 3 via StandOutfits; Nenyoo uses slot 5. Clothing fidelity can differ.

Nenyoo named-prop import handles slots 0..7 and omits Hip; named Cherax face_features are not the featureN keys read in its face-feature branch.
Nenyoo vehicle apply_cherax handles a subset of Cherax vehicle fields; Scooby and Nenyoo may differ in attachment and cosmetic fidelity.
Model availability, clothing indices and DLC resources depend on the installed GTA edition/build.
No compatibility extension to Lua, themes or translations is inferred from these data importers.
